title: What is Amazon S3? (storage classes)
note: Lesson 2.2 fix (AWS-L22-001, K11): re-fetched and confirmed this overview backs S3's range of storage classes, including that S3 One Zone-IA stores data in a single Availability Zone rather than the multi-AZ redundancy of S3's other classes; the page itself does not state the eleven-nines/three-plus-AZ durability figures, which were separately verified in the AWS-L22 review against the S3 DataDurability page.
